question: What was ordered quantity per order for the full year 2025? Use the recorded order date for the 2025 scope.

action.query: SELECT SUM(ITEM_QUANTITY) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS ORDERED_QUANTITY_PER_ORDER, SUM(ITEM_QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_ORDERED_QUANTITY, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
action.metrics: Total item quantity divided by order count; includes all orders recorded in 2025, regardless of status.

action.answer: For orders with recorded ORDER_DATE from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, ordered quantity averaged 2.805393 items per order. This covers all 4,359,773 orders (all statuses), totaling 12,230,877 ordered items.

final_answer: For orders with recorded ORDER_DATE from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, ordered quantity averaged 2.805393 items per order. This covers all 4,359,773 orders (all statuses), totaling 12,230,877 ordered items.
